name: Gemina
description: Extract, search and tag any document — invoices, receipts, contracts, forms, or your own custom templates. One remote Streamable HTTP endpoint, 13 tools + 2 prompts. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 or use an API key. Data residency per account: EU, US, Israel or Asia.

auth.note: Two ways in. (1) OAuth 2.1: connect with no headers and the client discovers the authorization server via RFC 9728/8414 and opens a browser sign-in (Claude Code /mcp, claude.ai / Claude Desktop connectors, Cursor, VS Code). (2) API key: send X-API-Key (or Authorization: Bearer) for headless use. The same key works for MCP and REST. Anonymous tools/list and prompts/list are served at the discoveryEndpoint.

tools.name: files_create_upload
tools.description: Reserve a pre-signed PUT slot for a file you'll tag. Returns file_id, the upload URL, and the headers to echo on the PUT.

tools.name: tag_file
tools.description: Run the FileTag pipeline on an uploaded slot: metadata, six filename patterns, and a short-lived enriched-file URL.

tools.name: tag_url
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTPS URL server-side and tag it. The bytes never pass through the model context.

tools.name: files_create_extraction_upload
tools.description: Reserve a pre-signed PUT slot for extraction (distinct from the FileTag slot).

tools.name: extract_document
tools.description: Run one or more extraction types on an uploaded slot: ocr, invoice_headers, invoice_line_items, document_details_hebrew, document_line_items_hebrew, custom_template.

tools.name: get_extraction_result
tools.description: Poll an asynchronous extraction by meta.correlationId.

tools.name: list_extractions
tools.description: List past extractions, newest first, with filters and pagination.

tools.name: get_extraction
tools.description: Fetch one extraction by id, including the full extracted data.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch one document by id, including all of its extractions.

tools.name: submit_extraction_feedback
tools.description: Send verified/corrected field values back: the extraction-quality feedback loop.

tools.name: query_documents
tools.description: Search your indexed documents: structured filters, semantic similarity, or hybrid (best default).

tools.name: aggregate_documents
tools.description: Sums/averages/min/max/counts over indexed documents, grouped by vendor, currency, type, month, and more.

tools.name: index_document
tools.description: (Re)index one document into the searchable index, after corrections or to backfill.

prompts.name: explain_filename_patterns
prompts.description: The six filename patterns and when to use each.

rateLimits.monthly: 1,500 FileTag tags on the free tier; larger allowances and the paid tool groups on paid plans
